summary: Fixed fees: a 125cc gasoline scooter pays NT$450/yr road-maintenance fee (公路養管費, formerly 汽燃費), NT$0 licence tax (150cc and under exempt) and, from 5 years old, a yearly exhaust test (fine NT$500 if skipped). Electric pays NT$0 fee (exempt, expected to end about 2030) and NT$0 licence tax (exempt to 2030-12-31 and zero below 20.19 HP anyway), so the fixed-fee saving is about NT$450/yr. Compulsory insurance is class-based, about NT$658/yr for 普通重型; no electric-specific rate was found. Routine service by the book: gasoline about NT$2,100-4,700/yr at 5,000 km and NT$4,200-9,200 at 10,000 km (dealer parts prices, no tyres); Gogoro-type about NT$850-1,200 and NT$850-1,950 on 2020 invoices (probably low today). Survey averages could not be confirmed. Tyres and brakes are equal. Electric downsides: fixed 6-month visits, battery plan fees and setup costs, plan price rises (Ionex complaints), costly out-of-warranty repairs (one owner NT$138,985 over 10 years), and weak used values (Gogoro dealer ranges NT$10,000-55,000). Taipei free city parking is 2023 data only.

findings.subject: 排氣定檢 timing for scooters
findings.valueText: 出廠滿5年的機車應於行照發照月份前後1個月每年接受1次排氣檢驗; 逾期罰500元, 逾期6個月仍未改善罰3,000元
